peer_review_reliability.definition: Reliability, consistency, and agreement in peer review of manuscripts or grant proposals
peer_review_reliability.scope_note: Generic model evaluation or review articles without assessment by reviewers are insufficient.

peer_review_bias.definition: Identity, gender, and blinding bias in single-blind or double-blind peer review
peer_review_bias.scope_note: Bias outside manuscript or grant review is insufficient.

bibliometric_evaluation.definition: Use, validity, and limitations of bibliometric indicators for evaluating research quality
bibliometric_evaluation.scope_note: Citation retrieval without evaluation of research quality is insufficient.
